Detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART with deliberate crisp square pixel clusters and stepped contours, matching reference, quiet rich bark detail, warm upper-left light. Square production canvas with full tree completely within 8 percent clear transparent border on every side. Root-base pivot approximately normalized (0.56,0.90), highest bare branch at y about 0.10, asymmetrical boughs from x0.10 to0.90 and y0.15 to0.70. Real alpha transparency outside wood and through all gaps, no backdrop, ground tile, frame, text, birds, large cast shadow or checkerboard. This is wood only for a layered evergreen tree, not seasonal leaf loss.

generation.prompt_exact: Generate ONLY a separate healthy EVERGREEN TORREY PINE NEEDLE CANOPY layer, Pinus torreyana, to place over bare wood image 1. Characteristic Torrey pine needles in five-needle fascicles clustered along the terminal shoots, airy wind-sculpted irregular bough islands rather than dense broadleaf blobs or symmetrical conifer triangle. Mainland Southern California coastal specimen: muted GRAY-GREEN and restrained olive, not saturated turquoise. Preserve image 1's square canvas coordinate system and asymmetric bough locations: high right crown spanning x0.45–0.90 y0.10–0.35; middle crown x0.35–0.80 y0.30–0.60; large low left bough spanning x0.10–0.43 y0.37–0.67; lower right terminal tufts x0.70–0.90 y0.48–0.72. Keep all needle tufts entirely within x0.07–0.93 and y0.07–0.74; lower center from y0.70 to1.00 remains fully transparent for the trunk/root. Leave enough gaps to see the underlying branch structure, but ensure foliage follows the visible branch tips instead of floating arbitrarily. Every needle must fit inside broad transparent outer margin. No background, text, checkerboard, UI or decorations. Foliage only as one RGBA production overlay; no wood or cones.

BOTTOM LEFT: ONE mature woody Torrey pine seed cone, stout ovoid form with many thick scaly geometric plates and small scale tips, naturally brown, oblique side view, no foliage or branch. BOTTOM RIGHT: one low ground litter cluster, two stout brown Torrey pine cones lying among a loose handful of straw-brown fallen long pine needles, no dirt tile, no green broad leaves, no shadow rectangle. Generous empty gutters, none of the four assets touches or overlaps another quadrant. Transparent gaps between every slender needle. No tree, no text, no labels, frame, checkerboard or UI. Real alpha outside assets, no scenery. These are four distinct individual source assets, not one joined arrangement. No orange whole crown or snow; evergreen needle turnover assets only.
